scope: Completed routed native21 stage21b digital PCB candidate; DFMA-13 through DFMA-24; engineering-prototype planning, no manufacturing or mains release
manufacturing_context: input/manufacturing-stage21b-final (manifest matches board c0158049; digital candidate, not manufacturing release)

findings.summary: J2/J5 74650074 require 1.6–2.0 mm board; final note now specifies 1.6–1.76 mm finished thickness to avoid ordinary nominal 1.6 mm ±10% reaching 1.44 mm, but supplier acceptance is open.
findings.consequence: Undersize finished board can invalidate the THR terminal interface.
findings.closure_check: Written finished-thickness lower bound and CTI/stack acceptance from selected fabricator; first-article coupon measurement.

findings.summary: 737 0.3 mm vias, including in-pad fields, need a controlled via covering/plating/inspection route; KiCad capping/filling flags and POFV order note differ.
findings.consequence: Uncontrolled interpretation can alter solder land planarity, plugging, inspection and cost.
findings.closure_check: Authoritative stage21b fab order instructions, selected process and acceptance of via treatment, drill plating and critical slots.

findings.summary: L-shaped outline and slots are geometrically defined, but panel rails, support and depanel/fit trials are absent.
findings.consequence: Assembly handling and separation may damage loaded board or enclosure mating features.
findings.closure_check: Dimensioned supplier-compatible panel and outline/slot tolerance drawing; populated depanel and enclosure first-article trial.

findings.summary: Modeled barriers pass, but finished-unit material CTI, edge/slot condition, contamination and certification basis remain unqualified.
findings.consequence: Digital copper distances alone do not prove product insulation after manufacture.
findings.closure_check: Agree insulation authority and material/process controls, then inspect and physically qualify representative assemblies.

findings.summary: Final Gerber/BOM/CPL and manifest match stage21b, but README still describes stage19b and old drill counts; FAB-NOTE still says 749 small vias, 36 test pads and 15 NPTH versus current 737/35/11.
findings.consequence: Revision-ambiguous written order/inspection packet can confuse quoting, fabrication instructions or incoming acceptance despite matching machine files.
findings.closure_check: Reconcile README and FAB-NOTE counts with current board/fab and explicit POFV order instruction; maintain the now-current stage21b manifest identity.

findings.summary: Consequential R5, U26, U41/U42, C5/C6 and THR custom lands/paste choices lack exact drawing overlay and first-article joint evidence.
findings.consequence: Electrical layout intent may conflict with the actual part or paste/reflow yield.
findings.closure_check: Overlay current exact MPN drawings against native pad/mask/paste and inspect representative solder joints.

findings.summary: Final rotation audit aligns C30/C31 and all 353 corrected coordinates, but still flags 50 NEEDS-PREVIEW and 10 CORRECTED placements; supplier Y-axis/rotation/polarity interpretation remains unverified.
findings.consequence: Coordinate/rotation/polarity interpretation cannot be inferred from native DRC or raw file parity.
findings.closure_check: Inspect the selected assembler's board preview and capture signed-off disposition for flagged placements and side/axis convention.

findings.summary: THR studs, 2 oz copper, large THT/SMT thermal mass and hidden U26 pad share an unvalidated paste/stencil/reflow route.
findings.consequence: Barrel fill, voiding and temperature margin could vary on real boards.
findings.closure_check: Approve stencil aperture and paste-in-hole volume, profile a loaded board and inspect representative THR/U26 joints.

findings.summary: Manual parts and lead/clip/fuse steps are inventoried but no timed station traveler or first-article operation inspection exists.
findings.consequence: Actual labor, ergonomic access and operation defect cost remain unknown.
findings.closure_check: Time and inspect a full SMT→THR→manual→clean→trim→test pilot build, including F1 clips and terminal torque.

findings.summary: C31/C24 F.CrtYd axis-aligned gap is 0.175 mm and local CAD silk warnings reach 199-report caps; exported Gerber review finds no ink-on-land, but nozzle/AOI/rework envelope and label visibility remain unknown.
findings.consequence: Dense region may constrain placement inspection or service despite zero electrical DRC errors.
findings.closure_check: Assembler nozzle/AOI/rework envelope review and first-article visibility trial for C24/C30/C31/U6; treat 199 as cap not count.

findings.summary: Power-pin preheat is mentioned, but critical removal/replacement limits and post-rework/depanel inspection are undefined.
findings.consequence: Heat or mechanical repair can damage via caps, dense small parts, joints or retained insulation.
findings.closure_check: Trial bounded critical-part rework and loaded depanel, then inspect solder, cleanliness, insulation and function.

improvement_angles.saving_mechanism: Avoid over- or under-specifying finished laminate and terminal attachment
improvement_angles.technical_benefit: Controlled stud interface and reproducible assembly
improvement_angles.tradeoff: A thicker stack or alternate termination changes plating, copper, thermal path, fit and cost
improvement_angles.smallest_test: Fabricator thickness capability/quote plus terminal-fit and enclosure sample

improvement_angles.saving_mechanism: Selective via treatment instead of blanket POFV, only if supplier-supported
improvement_angles.technical_benefit: Retain flat in-pad solder lands and critical thermal/current paths
improvement_angles.tradeoff: Uncovered or tent-only vias can degrade solder quality/insulation and complicate process control
improvement_angles.smallest_test: Two quoted process variants plus cross-section and paste/void inspection

improvement_angles.saving_mechanism: Spend small local area to reduce placement/rework fragility
improvement_angles.technical_benefit: Improved C24/C30/C31 nozzle, AOI and service access
improvement_angles.tradeoff: May change comparator return geometry, barrier clearance or routing
improvement_angles.smallest_test: One controlled placement variant checked against native envelope, electrical barriers and assembler tool model

improvement_angles.saving_mechanism: Improve material utilization with a supplier-compatible L-board array
improvement_angles.technical_benefit: Support and repeatable separation of loaded boards
improvement_angles.tradeoff: Rails/tabs/fixtures consume material and can damage enclosure mating edges
improvement_angles.smallest_test: Compare panel drawings and quotes, then depanel one representative loaded panel

improvement_angles.technical_benefit: Less labor and inspection burden without losing service/current/thermal requirements
improvement_angles.tradeoff: Part substitutions can shift cost or make repair worse
improvement_angles.smallest_test: Time F1 clips, radial parts, THR studs, lead trim and connectors on a pilot traveler

improvement_angles.saving_mechanism: Automated board-hash/BOM/CPL parity gate reduces wrong-build preparation and inspection work
improvement_angles.technical_benefit: Preserve exact 353-population/coordinate identity and known rotation deltas through each new revision
improvement_angles.tradeoff: Requires stable source identity and correct vendor-axis interpretation
improvement_angles.smallest_test: Re-run on final board c0158049, verify C30/C31 witnesses, then review selected assembler preview

limits: Digital and document review only; no supplier preview/order, physical sample, process capability, thermal/EMI/SPICE operating qualification, insulation certification or manufacturing release. DRC 199 warning counts are display caps; Gerber review reports no ink-on-land after mask subtraction. No board or producer package was modified by reviewer.

resolved_during_review.note: Earlier unreleased corrected CPL contradicted board/raw CPL; owner concurrently regenerated it. Reviewer made no hardware or producer-package edits.
